<question>
How much can a landlord in Germany ask for as a security deposit?
</question>

<answer>
In Germany, a landlord may ask for a security deposit of no more than three months' net rent, meaning the basic rent without heating and service charges. The tenant may pay it in three equal monthly installments. The landlord must keep the deposit separate from their own assets, usually in a savings account.
</answer>

</reference>
